These quick-xml versions are transitive dependencies (0.37.4 via opendal, 0.38.4 via quick-junit, 0.39.2 via typespec/azure_core) reachable only through the webhdfs and azure_blob sinks. The fix requires quick-xml 0.41.0, which crosses each crate's 0.x semver requirement; opendal (^0.37), quick-junit (^0.38), and typespec (^0.39) cannot be forced to 0.41.0 via cargo update, so remediation is blocked until those upstreams adopt quick-xml 0.41.

quick-xml 0.31.0 is pulled only by vector's optional windows_event_log source, whose code is gated behind #[cfg(windows)] and is not compiled into the Linux image. The crate appears in the SBOM because the feature is enabled at build time, but its parsing entrypoints are never reached on this platform.
